faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Los Altos Hills?
faq.answer: Los Altos Hills homeowners typically invest $18,000 to $50,000+ for window replacement projects. This exclusive Stanford-adjacent community features large estate homes on 1-acre+ lots, frequently with 20–35 windows and floor-to-ceiling glass walls. Custom sizing and premium hardware are the standard where median home values exceed $5 million. Single window installation starts at approximately $850.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Los Altos Hills?
faq.answer: Yes. Los Altos Hills requires a building permit for all window replacements. The town's Planning and Building Department evaluates projects for consistency with the community's natural, open-space character. Our team manages all permit applications and coordinates with town staff on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Los Altos Hills?
faq.answer: Los Altos Hills exclusively demands the highest-tier window products. We most frequently specify Marvin Ultimate wood-clad fiberglass for its unmatched customization and premium finishes, Western Window Systems for large folding and multi-slide door systems, and Andersen A-Series for traditional estate homes with authentic wood interiors.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Los Altos Hills neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve the entire Town of Los Altos Hills including Vineyards Road area, Moody Road corridor, Concepcion Road, and all estate properties throughout the community. Zip code: 94022.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Los Altos Hills?
faq.answer: Most Los Altos Hills projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
